title: A Lesson for All Humanity
art: The lights on the earth stand for every human life; one going dark and one flaring show the verse's meaning, not a historical event.
imagePrompt: One continuous rise: from a small mound of earth at night under a sky full of stars, past a bare tree, above the valley and the clouds, until the whole curved earth hangs against the stars, painted in ink-wash blues and greens, thousands of tiny points of light spread across its continents; one light gone dark with a ripple of shadow passing over the others, one light flaring with a wave of warm gold spreading across all of them; huge glowing Arabic calligraphy arching across the sky above the earth.

beats.say: The small mound lay under a sky full of stars.
Then the view rose: past the tree, above the valley, above the clouds.
Across the curve of the earth, every life that would ever be came on like a lamp.
One light went out, and a shadow passed over them all.

verse.en: whoever kills a soul unless for a soul or for corruption [done] in the land - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely.
And whoever saves one - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely.
